subject: Catalyst Labs — startup promo credit request
messages:
From: Marco Diaz <marco@catalystlabs.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst Labs — startup program credits request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Catalyst Labs is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. We're running an upcoming 12-week cohort and would like to request a promotional credit package beyond the standard trial so our 10 accepted startups can integrate Redwood into their demos.

What we're hoping for: a 90-day trial extension + an additional $10k in credits scoped to inference usage (text gen & embeddings). The cohort runs July 1 — Sept 30.

Attached is a short company profile and our cohort milestones CSV so you can see planned usage spikes. Please let me know what qualification you need from our side (incorporation docs, cohort roster, MOU). If there's a mutual action plan (MAP) template you prefer, happy to sign.

Also copying Sarah (program lead) who will handle logistics.

Appreciate you looking into this — can we get an eligibility check and rough timeline for approval by next Wednesday?

Best,
Marco Diaz
Head of Accelerator Partnerships
Catalyst Labs
Attachments: catalyst_company_profile.pdf (pdf), milestones.csv (csv)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marco Diaz <marco@catalystlabs.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalyst Labs — startup program credits request

Marco — thanks for the note and the materials, this looks aligned with other cohort pilots we've supported. Quick read-through suggests a few things we'll need before final approval:

- Confirmation of cohort roster (names + company domains)
- High-level security posture doc (SOC2 or equivalent summary) — we scope certain add-on approvals to customers with basic controls in place
- A short MAP that outlines demo obligations and usage milestones (we provide the template)

Operationally, we can provision a 90-day extension and reserve up to $10k in promo credits under a conditional approval: credits released in two tranches tied to demo completion and usage thresholds. Marcus, can you confirm if the legal/finance team needs any other gating items here? Laura, can you pull the MAP template and our standard cohort playbook?

Marco — I'll draft the MAP and share a DocuSign-ready copy. If everything checks out, timeline for final sign-off is 3–5 business days after we receive the roster + security summary.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-draft.docx (docx)

From: Sarah Klein <sarah@catalystlabs.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marco Diaz <marco@catalystlabs.io>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalyst Labs — startup program credits request

Hi Kimberly / Marcus / Laura — quick update from our side:

- Roster: attaching the provisional list of 10 companies with emails and demo leads. We can provide final roster by June 23.
- Security: 6 of 10 startups are pre-seed and don't have SOC2; they do have basic controls (password policies, limited access). Do you have a lighter checklist we can submit?
- MAP: happy to review the draft — we prefer the tranche tied to two demo milestones (mid-cohort and graduation demo).

Also, is Redwood open to a small co-marketing commitment in exchange for the full $10k release at graduation? We can add Redwood logos in cohort materials and host a joint webinar.

Thanks — attaching roster_now.csv.

Best,
Sarah Klein
Program Director, Catalyst Labs
Attachments: roster_now.csv (csv)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marco Diaz <marco@catalystlabs.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalyst Labs — startup program credits request

Folks — reviewed the materials (roster + company profile). We can approve the conditional promo package as proposed. Final terms:

- 90-day extension + $10,000 promo credits reserved (account-level), released in two tranches: $4,000 after mid-cohort demo completion, $6,000 after graduation demo and a short survey on integration/feedback.
- Eligibility gating: final roster + a one-page security checklist per startup (we'll accept a simple controls checklist for pre-seed companies).
- Co-marketing: Redwood can commit to the joint webinar and logo placement; marketing details to be finalized by our demand gen team.

Kimberly — please send the DocuSign MAP and we'll get legal to sign. Marco/Sarah — please upload the roster and the one-page security checklist items to the shared Drive link below so we can close by June 23.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DL-2025-0917
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPdraft

Once we have the roster + checklists, legal will issue the MAP and billing will set the promo credit hold.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Startup Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
